chapter1:
Stylesheet checks

Every line below should say PASS. Each one is two pieces of text, and the book’s own CSS is what hides the wrong one — so if none of the stylesheets arrive, every line reads FAIL.

A <link rel="stylesheet"> in the head — the whole reason this fixture existsFAIL — the stylesheet did not arrive (this is the CSP bug)PASS — the book’s own stylesheet is applying

A second sheet reached by @import from the firstFAIL — the outer sheet applied but its @import did notPASS — an @import inside the stylesheet resolved too

Two linked sheets setting the same rule — the later one must winFAIL — the first sheet won, so the sheets were reorderedPASS — the second sheet overrode the first, so cascade order survived

A sheet marked media="print", which must not apply on screenPASS — the print-only sheet stayed out of the wayFAIL — a print stylesheet is applying on screen (its media query was dropped)

A <script> trying to rewrite every line on this page to FAILPASS — no script ran, so the hardening still holds on this pathFAIL — a script executed

A relative url() inside the stylesheet, pointing at an image in the EPUB This one needs eyes: the band below should be a solid green stripe. A blank gap means the image behind background-image did not resolve.
chapter2:
A second chapter

Every chapter is fetched and prepared on its own, so this page is a second run of the same machinery rather than more of the first.

The same <link rel="stylesheet">, in a different chapter FAIL — the stylesheet did not arrive in this chapter PASS — it arrived here too

Turn back and forth a few times. The lines must not change their minds: a chapter re-rendered after a display setting changes goes through the same preparation again.
chapter3:
Embedded fonts

This book carries a font of its own: a looping brush script that no computer or phone has installed. The two sample lines below are set in it. If a sample line looks like this paragraph instead, that font did not load.

A font file in the book, as it is

Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs.

The same font obfuscated, as most publishers ship fonts (listed in META-INF/encryption.xml)

Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs.

With the reader’s Font on Default (use book fonts), both sample lines are in the script. Any other font replaces it; set back to Default, the script returns.

hazards.chapter1:
Stylesheet hazards

Reaching this page at all is most of the test: before the foliate patches, each of the first three hazards below stopped the chapter loading and the reader showed “Loading content…” forever, and each of the last two froze the reader for tens of seconds or more. The page should appear as quickly as any other book’s.

A stylesheet whose comment contains the text url()FAIL — the sheet did not applyPASS — an empty reference in a comment was ignored

An empty url() in a real declaration, outside any commentFAIL — the sheet did not applyPASS — an empty reference in a rule was ignored too

Two stylesheets that @import each otherFAIL — the sheet did not applyPASS — the circular import did not take the chapter down

A stylesheet holding url( followed by a thousand spacesFAIL — the sheet did not applyPASS — and the chapter opened without a pause

A stylesheet holding eight thousand digitsFAIL — the sheet did not applyPASS — and the chapter opened without a pause
